messages:
Sara: Heads-up: KMS partial outage in us-west caused some jump-hosts to switch to local keystore overnight. Ops had to use broader perms. Drafting mitigation runbook.

Kevin: Oof. Minimal privileges plan please — no clusterRoles.

Anna: Minimal: namespace SA (jump-hosts), Role with keystore.get/update and secrets.patch, ephemeral RoleBinding TTL=60m. Annotate with created-by.

Mike: I'll run a 2-host canary if it's scripted. Need audit slice for SOC.

ops-bot: Alert: KMS degraded 2026-03-22T23:12Z -> 2026-03-22T23:19Z. Error spike: 503s.

Sara: Draft steps: 1) create SA fallback-ops, 2) apply Role + ephemeral RoleBinding, 3) deploy local-keystore secret, 4) enable keystore/audit logging, 5) canary 2 hosts, 6) rotate fallback keys & revoke tokens.

Kevin: For audits: collect kube-audit + keystore plugin logs 23:00-23:30Z, gzip, SSE-KMS encrypt, upload to s3://redwood-soc-archives/kms-incidents/INC-2026-03122/. I'll own upload.

Anna: Sketch (to be pushed via gitops):
```
kubectl -n jump-hosts create sa fallback-ops
# Role with minimal verbs
kubectl -n jump-hosts apply -f role-keystore.yaml
# RoleBinding created by PR, controller will garbage-collect after TTL
```

Mike: Canary config: RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=200, RETRY_MAX=6. Emit metrics keystore.fallback.count and .latency_ms. Alert if count >5 in 5m -> pager. I'll run 09:30 PT.

Ellie: SOC needs correlation keys: request_id, host_instance_id, service_account, cosign_sig_id. Add to runbook outputs. Also require operators to `--record` actions.

Anna: I'll add a small controller to delete RoleBindings after TTL and require `created-by` annotation. PR template will enforce operator email and reason.

Sara: I'll add revoke step for any tokens minted with local creds and cosign re-attest checklist for images. Owners: Anna (binding & controller), Mike (canary), Kevin (audit export), Ellie (SOC triage), Sara (runbook + postmortem).

Sara: Runbook draft: https://internal.redwood/sops/runbooks/keystore-fallback-ephemeral (draft) — quick test snippets are included.

Kevin: After canary, pull audit slice: `kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-audit-collector --since-time="2026-03-22T23:00:00Z" | gzip > audit-slice.gz` then `aws s3 cp --sse aws:kms audit-slice.gz s3://redwood-soc-archives/...`

ops-bot: Reminder: open INC-2026-03122 and tag #security #infra #soc.

Mike: Thanks — will post canary run results and any anomalies. Keep the runbook PR links in-thread for compliance.

Sara: Closing notes: do not widen cluster perms; prefer ephemeral, auditable bindings only. Will merge PRs and close thread once artifacts uploaded.
